annotations.title: Check plan coverage for a destination

description: Answer "does this eSIM plan work in X?" for one destination, as a yes or no rather than a country list. Takes a plan id and a destination (a country name or two-letter code). Reports whether the destination is covered, and separately whether it is explicitly excluded from an otherwise regional plan. Use get-plan-coverage when you need the full list of countries instead.

destination.description: The country to check: a name ("Japan") or a two-letter code ("JP").

plan_id.description: The plan id (a ULID) as returned by list-plans.

name: check-coverage

covered.description: Whether this plan works at that destination.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "JP". Null when the destination resolved to nothing, or when the plan names the country without publishing a code for it.

name.description: The country as we know it, e.g. "Japan". Null when the destination resolved to nothing.

query.description: What you asked about, echoed back.

excluded.description: Whether the destination is explicitly carved OUT of an otherwise regional plan. A different fact from simply not being included, and the only one of the two that means "do not buy this for that trip". Never true at the same time as covered.

is_worldwide.description: Whether the plan is sold as worldwide.

note.description: The answer in a sentence, including what to do next when it is a no.

region_label.description: Readable scope of a regional plan, e.g. "Europe". Null for a country plan.

total_countries.description: How many countries the plan covers in total.

title: Check plan coverage for a destination
